sources.title: Poll: NFL Ducks QB Predictions
sources.description: What’s going on, y’all? With the NFL season rapidly approaching, I thought I’d ask y’all which #ProDuck quarterback will have the best season this year. Let us know! (Yes, I know Shough transferred, but I still claim him and root for him, so he’s on my list). As always, ‘Sco Ducks!
